paragraph: A presidential order, Despacho 300/26 of 13 August 2026, [authorised US$28 million and opened a public tender](<https://pti.ao/pr-aprova-usd-28-milhoes-para-aquisicao-de-plataforma-de-identidade-digital-e-assinaturas-electronicas/>) for a national digital identity and e-signature platform. The platform is meant to let citizens and companies verify the identity of their customers electronically. In the last twelve months this order is the one step found. It is to be bought through the tender, and no source found since October 2023 says a service in use checks people against the ID. Establishing would need a service in use checking people against the national ID, such as SIM registration or a bank's KYC.

No stage is set. Since June 2026 SIM registration in Burundi has accepted only the national ID card as the identity document. Nothing found since October 2023 says SIM registration, or any other system, checks people against an ID register. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No bank KYC check or social programme enrolment against the register has been found either. Preparing would need another system's use of the national ID to be contracted, being built or piloted, such as a SIM-registration link or a bank's KYC check.

[ANIP reports 25 million digital eKYC verifications completed in 2025 and 3.8 million authentications by telecom operators](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202602/benin-reports-75-of-identification-services-accessed-through-digital-platforms>). A second ANIP presentation of May 2026 counts [27 million identity verification requests in 2025](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T4-1-S2-3-Benin-FINAL.pdf>). [By 11 July 2026 the government's data-exchange dashboard showed 35,892,607 requests received by ANIP](<https://statistiques.xroad.bj/>), its second most-used provider. In the last twelve months, since 1 November 2026, [the criminal record certificate on service-public.bj is issued at once](<https://beninwebtv.bj/en/digitization-in-benin-criminal-records-now-issued-instantly-and-without-supporting-documents/>). The system checks of the applicant against the Personal Identification Number and the civil registry.

No stage is set. One instrument found is [Decree 2018-1270 on subscriber identification](<https://www.mdenp.gov.bf/details?cHash=39e4d35475f647d7bf216d77fd470a68&tx_news_pi1%5Baction%5D=detail&tx_news_pi1%5Bcontroller%5D=News&tx_news_pi1%5Bnews%5D=437>), which concerns SIM card sales. Nothing found since October 2023 names another system checking people against the national ID. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No SIM-registration link, bank KYC check or social programme enrolment against the national ID has been found. Preparing would need another system's use of the national ID to be contracted, being built or piloted.

In the last twelve months, in July 2026 [Bank Gaborone began checking new customers against their Omang and a selfie](<https://weekendpost.co.bw/bank-gaborone-launches-digital-self-onboarding-platform-making-banking-simpler-and-more-accessible/>), as part of automated KYC. The Bankers' Association of Botswana has launched [a national eKYC project](<https://www.businesstechafrica.co.za/article/botswana-launches-national-ekyc-project-to-make-bank-verification-easier>) that lets banks verify customers against the national citizen database. In March 2026 the health ministry said [its Client Registry was ready for deployment](<https://www.botswanaspeaks.gov.bw/media/COMMITTEE%20OF%20SUPPPLY%20SPEECHES/HEALTH-Committee%20of%20Supply%20Speech%20-%20FINAL%2004-03-2026%20Vol%20I.pdf>), identifying patients by Omang or passport number. No source found since October 2023 shows a second sector checking against the ID. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID.

[ONECI, the identity office, says it put identity checks for know-your-customer rules in place for banks and financial institutions in 2025](<https://www.koaci.com/article/2026/02/10/cote-divoire/societe/cote-divoire-le-delai-de-delivrance-de-la-carte-nationale-didentite-ramene-a-moins-de-deux-semaines-perspectives-de-la-structure-pour-2026_194217.html>). [In February 2025 Orange Bank Africa signed a convention with ONECI](<https://www.koaci.com/article/2025/02/03/cote-divoire/economie/cote-divoire-signature-dune-convention-entre-oba-et-loneci-pour-renforcer-la-securite-des-transactions_184218.html>) to verify its customers through ONECI's authentication APIs. In the last twelve months, [on 2 April 2026 the social safety net programme signed a convention with ONECI](<https://filetsociaux-ci.org/registre-social-unique-des-menages-pauvres-et-vulnerables-rsu-signature-dune-convention-entre-le-bureau-de-coordination-du-programme-filets-sociaux-bcpfs-et-loffice-nation/>) to verify social registry beneficiaries against the national register of persons. Nothing found counts the checks made. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID, shown by sources from the past three years.

No stage is set. A 2026 payroll census in Cameroon required the national ID card as a document. Nothing found since October 2023 says another system checks people against the ID. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No SIM-registration link, bank KYC check or social programme enrolment against the ID has been found. Preparing would need another system's use of the national ID to be contracted, being built or piloted.

In March 2024 the identity office said [its contract includes a KYC platform for private companies to verify identities](<https://scooprdc.net/2024/03/27/rdc-lonip-presente-le-plan-de-mise-en-oeuvre-du-programme-de-fichier-general-de-la-population-et-de-la-delivrance-de-la-carte-didentite-nationale-aux-congolais/>), with online verification scheduled from December 2025 to 2028. In the last twelve months, in June 2026 the government [launched RDC-Pass in Kinshasa](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202606/drc-launches-rdc-pass-digital-id-platform-under-20-year-ppp-with-trident>). It includes biometric SIM registration and automated identity checks for financial institutions, starting with audits and pilots. In August 2026 the digital economy ministry signed an [MoU with Equity BCDC](<https://acp.cd/economie/numerique-signature-dun-protocole-daccord-sur-la-modernisation-de-lecosysteme-financier/>), a commercial bank. No source found says a check against the ID is in service. Establishing would need a service in use checking people against the national ID, such as SIM registration or a bank's KYC.

No stage is set. The items found for Comoros concern the production of biometric passports and national ID cards. Nothing found since October 2023 names another system checking people against the national ID. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No SIM-registration link, bank KYC check or social programme enrolment against the national ID has been found. Preparing would need another system's use of the national ID to be contracted, being built or piloted.

The Portal de Justiça, launched on 18 December 2024, [is integrated with the state's Autentika platform](<https://www.governo.cv/primeiro-ministro-preside-acto-de-lancamento-oficial-do-portal-de-justica/>). The Autentika page [says more than 95,000 users use the platform daily](<https://portal-autentika.gov.cv/>) to reach work applications. In the last twelve months, in March 2026 SNIAC [published an ID card toolkit](<https://sniac.cv/mw/>) for public or private services to authenticate card holders in their own applications. In May 2026 the justice modernisation institute IMIJ [counted more than 30 million data requests on SNIAC and over 50 connected services](<https://imij.gov.cv/noticias/cms-noticia-44>). The services connected include private ones, banks above all.

In July 2026 the director general of the population and family directorate said [it is building an interoperability system](<https://www.lanation.dj/notre-vision-est-de-faire-de-la-direction-generale-de-la-population-et-de-la-famille-une-administration-entierement-modernisee-interconnectee-et-proche-des-citoyens-abdi-abdillahi-obsie/>). Administrations, banks and social protection bodies would then be able to check the authenticity of a national ID card in real time. He spoke of the system in the future tense, as work still under way. In the last twelve months this interview is the one step found. No source found since October 2023 says a service in use checks people against the ID. Establishing would need a service in use checking people against the national ID, such as a bank's KYC or a social programme.

In December 2025 the Interior Minister said [public bodies connected to the national identification number system obtain identity data electronically](<https://www.algerie360.com/les-administrations-nont-plus-le-droit-dexiger-ces-documents-saayoud-promet-des-sanctions-severes/>). In the last twelve months, in August 2026 the Sports Ministry's [WADHIFATI platform began identifying users through the national digital identity](<https://www.horizons.dz/2026/08/les-plateformes-du-ministere-des-sports-integrees-dans-lecosysteme-national-des-services-numeriques/>). In October 2026 the digitalisation commission [presented a kit for reading biometric documents](<https://news.prixalgerie.com/identite-numerique-algerie-gouvernance-donnees/>). The banks' KYC rules found do not name the national ID register. Nothing found since October 2023 shows services in two or more sectors checking people against the ID. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID, shown by sources from the past three years.

Digified, licensed by the financial regulator, [checks clients of lenders, investors and insurers against the national ID database](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202508/digified-licensed-to-offer-digital-kyc-e-signature-services-in-egypt>). In the last twelve months, in August 2026 [SIM registration began comparing each applicant's selfie with the national ID photograph](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/egypt-expands-biometric-sim-registration-after-identity-misuse-case>). The Ministry of Social Solidarity's [foster-family services sign citizens in through the digital identity system](<https://www.youm7.com/story/2026/8/29/التضامن-تطلق-أولى-مراحل-منظومة-الخدمات-الرقمية-الخاصة-بالأسر-البديلة/7529204>). From 7 November 2026 the remote power-of-attorney service [checks each citizen's face against the state's biometric record before signing](<https://www.vetogate.com/5767586>). Digified says it handles over 25 million verifications a year, which is the vendor's own total and not a count of checks against the ID. Mature would need a figure for verifications made against the ID, or a count of the services relying on it.

Faydaverse counted [150 integrated partners and over 208 million eKYC verifications on Fayda](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202610/ethiopia-launches-developer-sandbox-to-support-fayda-digital-id-innovation-integration>) as of 9 October 2026. Banks [retrieve KYC information and biometric authentication from Fayda](<https://addisfortune.news/banks-baulk-at-a-bill-from-public-id-that-turns-commercial>). FaydaVerse has [charged banks and others for verification since August 2026](<https://capitalethiopia.com/2026/10/18/faydaverse-begins-charging-banks-for-digital-id-verification/>). In the last twelve months, in November 2026 the Agricultural Transformation Institute [linked its farmer registration to Fayda](<https://capitalethiopia.com/2026/11/08/ethiopia-targets-four-million-farmers-for-digital-registration-by-2028/>). Nearly one million farmers are enrolled, and those without an ID number are sent to be enrolled first.

[The Digital Gabon financing agreement, amended with effect from 2 September 2026, funds digital authentication of social protection beneficiaries against the RBPP ID system](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099090226132027563/pdf/P175987-8dfb5a41-ff83-4fc0-a597-c588997e88ba.pdf>). The same amendment funds better ID authentication for the civil service HR system. In the last twelve months, [in April 2026 the tax authority and the social funds began a single salary declaration](<https://www.gabonreview.com/dus-un-tournant-numerique-pour-la-transparence-salariale-au-gabon/>) in which the employee's personal ID number becomes compulsory. The declaration makes the number compulsory and describes no check against the ID. No service in use is shown checking people against the ID. Establishing would need a service in use checking people against the national ID, such as SIM registration, a bank's KYC or a social programme.

[In February 2024 the NIA said banks and other financial institutions verify clients against its database in real time](<https://www.ghanaweb.com/GhanaHomePage/NewsArchive/191-financial-institutions-now-have-seamless-access-to-National-Identification-Authority-Data-1914728>). [Since January 2024 the government payroll has checked employees and pensioners against the NIA database](<https://nia.gov.gh/government-launches-integrated-database-for-payroll-validation-and-verification/>) to remove ghost names. In the last twelve months, [the NIA said in May 2026 that its verification system had processed over 200 million requests](<https://icnghana.com/nia-has-registered-over-19-4-million-ghanaians-executive-secretary/>). [The Interior Minister put 2025's biometric verifications at over 125 million](<https://today.com.gh/muntaka-nia-clears-ghana-card-backlog-registers-418000-children/>) in August 2026. [Under L.I. 2523, institutions must now check the Ghana Card biometrically against the national register](<https://nia.gov.gh/>), and the NIA began compliance monitoring in November 2026.

[On 22 January 2026 the electoral body DGE and ONECI signed a convention on voter identification](<https://mediaguinee.com/2026/01/conakry-la-dge-et-loneci-scellent-une-alliance-pour-un-fichier-electoral-fiable/>). Under it the national register of persons (RNPP) is to be the sole official source of voter identification data, which feeds the biometric electoral file. In the last twelve months this convention is the one step found, and elections the one sector it covers. No source found since October 2023 says a service in use checks people against the ID. Establishing would need a service in use checking people against the national ID, such as a bank's KYC.

In 2025 [the World Bank ID4D diagnostic says the Drivers License System uses the National ID system for biometric verification of applicants](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102025103014657/pdf/P502279-e8627dee-4568-45e7-bb51-9a1aea1ff040.pdf>), to prevent identity fraud and duplication. The same diagnostic says the national ID's NIN was used to cross-verify parents' IDs in the civil registration system. It reports that [user acceptance testing of health insurance cards built on the eCRVS and electronic ID was completed in April 2025](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099102025103014657/pdf/P502279-e8627dee-4568-45e7-bb51-9a1aea1ff040.pdf>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows services in two or more sectors checking against the ID. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID, shown by sources from the past three years.

[Kenya's 2026 ID4Africa presentation says IPRS and eCitizen give real-time authentication against the national ID](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-1-3-Kenya-FINAL.pdf>). It lists six sectors connected to ID verification: tax, health insurance, education, bank eKYC, SIM registration and social protection. It counts over 22,000 government services online that rely on the digital ID for access. In the last twelve months, [a 2026 health campaign began enrolling children aged 7 to 17 into Maisha Namba](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202606/kenya-expands-digital-id-program-to-minors-through-health-sector-rollout>), to link each child's health record to the ID. No count of individual checks against the ID has been found.

Since a May 2024 agreement with the Civil Service Agency, [national ID numbers are used to verify the payroll](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202503/liberia-says-national-id-system-drives-digital-economy-facilitates-service-delivery>) and find ghost workers. [In June 2025 the registry's director said financial institutions are fully integrated with its KYC system](<https://liberianinvestigator.com/government-extends-national-id-deadline-to-august-31/>). In the last twelve months, [the April 2026 ID concession plans checks for banking, health, passports, land, business registration and telecoms](<https://newrepubliclib.com/concerns-mount-over-nir-us52m-biometric-id-concession-jeopardizing-jobs-data-and-revenue-security/>). No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for verifications or counts the services relying on the ID. Mature would need a figure for verifications made against the ID, or a count of the services relying on it.

[In April 2026 the General Information Authority and the Central Bank of Libya reviewed linking the Level 3 biometric digital identity to banking systems for eKYC](<https://www.gia.gov.ly/en/2026/04/19/general-information-authority-central-bank-of-libya-national-authority-for-combating-money-laundering-with-the-relevant-authorities/>). [Technical trials with the Central Bank and several banks had already begun](<https://www.gia.gov.ly/en/2026/04/19/general-information-authority-central-bank-of-libya-national-authority-for-combating-money-laundering-with-the-relevant-authorities/>). A February 2025 summary of the digital identity project said government departments already match national numbers when completing some digital services for citizens. In the last twelve months the April 2026 review is the one dated step found. No source found since October 2023 shows services in two or more sectors checking against the ID. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID, shown by sources from the past three years.

In September 2025 [Minister Lephema said legal identity had let citizens open bank accounts, access credit and use mobile money](<https://www.thereporter.co.ls/2025/09/16/education-sector-lags-behind-in-id-integrationlephema/>). In the last twelve months, a FinMark Trust blog of June 2026 [lists Lesotho's digital identity cards among domestic eKYC frameworks with financial services use cases](<https://finmark.org.za/knowledge-hub/blog/building-a-cross-border-dpi-for-financial-inclusion-in-sadc>). In July 2026 [the Independent Electoral Commission told an African Union mission that its voter registration system is linked to the National Identity and Civil Registry](<https://sundayexpress.co.ls/?p=36187>). In January 2024 [the commission had said an earlier link with Home Affairs was abandoned](<https://publiceyenews.com/2024/01/30/iec-to-partner-home-affairs-ministry-in-seamless-database-project/>). The only count found is of voters registered. Mature would need a figure for verifications made against the ID, or a count of the services relying on it.

In 2025 the police and the digital transition ministry [agreed to let all government bodies verify the digital ID through a trusted third party](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202505/morocco-boosts-digital-id-use-for-govt-services-with-new-public-sector-partnerships>). In 2024 the police counted [17 framework agreements and more than 30 authorised bodies](<https://barlamantoday.com/2024/12/24/2024-dgsn-recap-cnie-2-0-expands-from-identification-to-comprehensive-digital-service-tool/>). In the last twelve months, in 2026, [registrations for social programmes were checked against the population register through its authentication service](<https://connect.mosip.io/resources_pdf_2026/Collaborations_between_Governments_and_Academic_Institutions.pdf>). A 2026 presentation counts [more than 70 million authentications and 47 million KYC checks](<https://connect.mosip.io/resources_pdf_2026/Collaborations_between_Governments_and_Academic_Institutions.pdf>) against the population register.

[Decree 2023-0679 of 16 November 2023 makes identification of every state and local civil servant compulsory](<https://sgg-mali.ml/JO/2023/mali-jo-2023-34.pdf>). Each agent's data is matched against the biometric records of RAVEC, the civil-status census. [Since February 2023 the telecoms regulator has had operators identify SIM cards by the NINA number](<https://www.digitalbusiness.africa/mali-lamrtp-edifie-les-consommateurs-sur-limportance-de-lidentification-des-cartes-sim/>), and [in July 2025 it barred SIM sales without an ID carrying the NINA](<https://bamada.net/identification-des-abonnes-telephoniques-lamrtp-renforce-les-mesures-de-fiabilite-autour-du-nina-et-de-lacquisition-des-cartes-sim>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. The SIM rules record the number, and no check against the register is described. Establishing would need a service in use checking people against the national ID, such as SIM registration, a bank's KYC or a social programme.

[On 20 March 2026 the World Bank reported its identity verification API was awaiting feedback from institutions](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099042226205030950/pdf/P172350-ea7be2a4-0727-4372-a851-4df42faaf183.pdf>). The identification directorate built the service for other institutions to check people against the national ID. [No relying party was using the verification services at that date](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099042226205030950/pdf/P172350-ea7be2a4-0727-4372-a851-4df42faaf183.pdf>), against a project target of six. In the last twelve months this report is the one step found. No service in use was found checking people against the national ID by March 2026. Establishing would need a service in use checking people against the national ID, such as SIM registration, a bank's KYC or a social programme.

[The Khadamati app relies on Houwiyeti to verify users' national identity](<https://techrek.info/fr/houwiyeti-de-nouveau-operationnelle-de-la-maintenance-periodique-a-la-question-de-la-souverainete-numerique/>), Tech Rek reported in August 2026. Khadamati groups more than 15 digital public services, and private financial apps use Houwiyeti to check users when they register. In the last twelve months, on 24 March 2026 the data protection authority [gave a conditional favourable opinion on Maadeni](<https://www.apd.mr/%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%85%d8%af%d8%a7%d9%88%d9%84%d8%a9-%d8%b1%d9%82%d9%85002-2026-%d8%aa%d8%aa%d8%b6%d9%85%d9%86-%d8%b1%d8%a3%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d8%a8%d8%ae%d8%b5%d9%88%d8%b5-%d9%85%d9%82%d8%b1%d8%b1-%d9%85/>), Maaden Mauritanie's information system for gold operators. Its stated purposes include a link to the national population register. No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for verifications or counts the services relying on Houwiyeti. Mature would need a source from the past three years giving a figure for verifications made against the ID, or counting the services relying on it.

In August 2024 the government said [public bodies and businesses would get an app to verify identity through the Mobile ID](<https://defimedia.info/carte-didentite-la-mobile-id-est-une-realite>). In the last twelve months, since 29 September 2026, [about 884,000 licence holders can view their digital driving licence on the KOREK! app](<https://lexpress.mu/node/563226>), where MauPass identifies and authenticates them. In 2022 [MauPass checked names and ID numbers against the population database](<https://oecd-opsi.org/innovations/maupass/>). No source found since October 2023 shows services in two or more sectors checking against the ID. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID.

UNDP says [Airtel and TNM tied biometric SIM registration to the Bureau's systems](<https://www.undp.org/sites/g/files/zskgke326/files/2026-02/undp_idt4m_annual_report_2025_web.pdf>) in 2025. The National Registration Bureau lists [links with Airtel Malawi for SIM registration and mobile money, and with seven banks and Mukuru for KYC](<https://www.nrb.gov.mw>). UNDP reports that [the Bureau's QR verification platform authenticated more than 1.2 million farmers](<https://www.undp.org/malawi/news/malawi-earns-global-recognition-digital-innovation-e-government>) for the Farm Input Subsidy Programme. In the last twelve months, the Bureau's [2026 fee regulations](<https://malawi24.com/2026/08/17/nrb-hikes-registration-fees/>) set charges for e-KYC checks. The Nzika digital ID wallet, launched on 16 September 2026, [was still piloted with one bank in November, and some banks refused it](<https://malawi24.com/2026/11/09/malawis-nzika-digital-id-bounced-at-the-bank/>).

In July 2025 [Instant Payments Namibia's COO said the instant payment system will need to use the national registration database for onboarding](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202507/namibia-weighs-biometrics-options-for-foundation-of-instant-payment-system>). [Namibia's Chief Registrar reports](<https://apai-crvs.uneca.org/sites/default/files/resourceuploads/day-2-interoperability-namibia.pdf>) that the home affairs and social protection ministries integrated the National Population Registration System with the social protection system. It verifies beneficiaries' existence and live status against the population register. In the last twelve months, in July 2026 [OPM's Director of Architecture said government has already saved about N$16 million on social grants](<https://informante.web.na/?p=398234>) through electronic identity verification. No source found since October 2023 shows a second sector checking against the ID. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID.

In July 2026 the WURI Niger project said it is [building a National Population Register](<https://www.lesahel.org/wuri-niger-restructure-une-opportunite-pour-une-identification-universelle-de-la-population-au-service-de-linclusion-et-du-un-puissant-facteur-de-developpement-inclusif-et-une-dimension/>) to identify and authenticate anyone seeking public or private services that require identification. Its first enrolment, in Niamey's five arrondissements, was due within weeks. The project also [funds an interoperability framework to offer identity verification and authentication](<https://www.lesahel.org/presentation-du-projet-didentification-unique-pour-lintegration-regionale-et-linclusion-en-afrique-de-louest-wuri-niger-un-projet-pour-renforcer-l/>) to public and private service providers. In the last twelve months these are the steps found. Nothing found since October 2023 says a service in use checks people against the ID. Establishing would need a service in use checking people against the national ID, such as a bank's KYC or SIM registration.

On 14 October 2026 [NIMC's Alvan Ikoku said about 63 government agencies had integrated with NIMC through its API for verification services](<https://techcabal.com/2026/10/14/nimc-identity-database-locally-hosted/>). They include bodies in examinations, student finance, consumer credit and health insurance. [President Tinubu has ordered every ministry, department and agency to adopt NINAuth as the default verification layer](<https://techmoonshot.com/2026/10/05/nimcs-ninauth-mandate-and-nigerias-180m-nin-push/>). [NIMC reports over 1.3 million identity verifications a day through NINAuth](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/digital-id-assessments-highlight-financial-inclusion-gains-across-africa>). In the last twelve months, [on 16 November 2026 the aviation minister launched V-Pass](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202611/nigeria-sets-december-31-deadline-for-airlines-to-adopt-v-pass-biometric-checks>), which checks domestic passengers against NIN data, with airlines to join by 31 December.

A [2024 regulation requires SIM registration to be checked against the national ID database](<https://www.rura.rw/fileadmin/user_upload/RURA/Documents/Sectors/ICT/Regulatory_Instruments/ICT_Regulations_and_Guidelines/Regulation_Governing_SIM_Card_Registration_in_Rwanda.pdf>). Operators [piloted biometric SIM registration](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202409/rwanda-conducts-pilot-to-implement-biometric-sim-registration-verification>) under it. In the last twelve months, in May 2026 the ID agency showed [the digital ID integrating with Irembo, the social registry, e-Ubuzima health, the education system and finance eKYC](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-1-Rwanda-FINAL.pdf>). It described these as a ready integration pathway. The agency's head said [banks, hospitals, telecoms and government bodies are expected to use its authentication by June 2027](<https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/34398/news/technology/govt-sets-2027-deadline-for-full-shift-to-digital-id>). No source found since October 2023 says a service in use checks people against the ID. Establishing would need a service in use checking people against the national ID, such as a bank's KYC.

In September 2026 [SUNA reported that Omdurman National Bank became the first bank in Sudan to activate the link](<https://www.suna.sd/posts/bnk-am-drman-alotny-aol-bnk-ytyh-thdyth-byanat-alaamlaaa-rkmya-bastkhdam-sodabas>). SudaPass verifies its customers' identity. [The Central Bank of Sudan issued a circular adopting the national number for opening bank accounts](<https://cbos.gov.sd/ar/news/%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%AA%D9%85%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%82%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%88%D8%B7%D9%86%D9%8A>). It requires banks to check the number against the Civil Registry's system. In the last twelve months, the Ministry of Digital Transformation and the Central Bank have been connecting the remaining banks one by one. No source found since October 2023 shows a second sector checking against the ID. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID.

[The e-Sénégal single-window app was launched on 24 March 2026 and built by SENUM SA](<https://www.ndarinfo.com/Comment-obtenir-ses-documents-administratifs-en-ligne-avec-la-nouvelle-appli-e-Senegal_a43744.html>), giving access through authentication on the NIN carried on the biometric identity card. In the last twelve months, [IPRES, the pension institution, opened its three-month periodic proof-of-life campaign on 1 July 2026 on the Maa ngi nii platform](<https://aps.sn/lipres-annonce-le-debut-de-la-campagne-periodique-de-collecte-de-preuve-de-vie-ce-mercredi/>). Pensioners must hold their ECOWAS national identity card to complete it. No check against the register is stated. No source found since October 2023 shows services in two or more sectors checking against the ID. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID.

In June 2025 [NCRA's Deputy Director of ICT named banking, public education and employment as requiring the NIN](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202506/sierra-leone-reaches-93-percent-national-id-coverage-80-percent-services-digitized>). In August 2025 [NCRA, the regulator and the mobile operators signed an agreement on NIN-SIM integration](<http://www.thesatellitenews.com/index.php/de/announcements/23-news-articles/1837-to-fast-track-nin-integration-with-telecom-services-ncra-natca-sign-mou-with-mnos-for-nin-sim-linkage>). In the last twelve months, on 20 October 2026 the National Communications Authority said mobile subscribers must [link their National Identification Number to their SIM by 1 November 2026](<https://thecalabashnewspaper.com/archives/65628>). On 4 August 2026 [Minister Salima Bah told Parliament](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/salima-bah-government-on-mobile-money-fraud/>). She said the Government remains committed to completing the SIM registration and NIN linkage exercise. No source found since October 2023 gives a figure for verifications or a count of the services relying on it. Mature would need a figure for verifications, or a count of the services relying on the ID.

[UNDP Somalia reports that Hubiye eKYC serves 1.2 million citizens with real-time identity verification across 25 integrated services](<https://www.undp.org/somalia/stories/driving-digital-transformation-somalia-2025-highlights>). They include the whole commercial banking sector. [The Central Bank of Somalia says about 20 thousand verifications were made since September 2025](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-3-Somalia-FINAL.pdf>). In the last twelve months, in October 2026 NIRA put [Hubiye into operation as the platform through which service providers verify ID credentials](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202611/somalia-puts-hubiye-national-id-verification-platform-into-operation>). [The Accountant General said in August 2026 that the government payroll will be linked to the national ID](<https://en.goobjoog.com/somalia-to-link-government-payroll-system-with-national-id-database/>). A pilot runs from 1 October 2026.

In February 2025 the Central Bank's Deputy Governor said [financial institutions are integrated with the national database centre](<https://www.centralbank.org.sz/wp-content/uploads/2021/04/Deputy-Governors-Speech-The-Nexus-between-AML-CFT-and-Financial-Inclusion-February-2025.pdf>). [In March 2025 the Deputy Governor said banks verify customer identification against the national civil registry through it](<https://www.bis.org/review/r250311k.htm>). In September 2025 the Times of Eswatini reported that [banks, financial service providers, regulators and ministries met on a national e-KYC registry](<https://www.times.co.sz/business/readmore.php?bhsadjgfoh=Eswatini+embarks+on+national+e-KYC+system&bvhdgsj=Business+and+Economy&yiphi=1080>). No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows services in two or more sectors checking against the ID. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID, shown by sources from the past three years.

[At its launch on 1 November 2022 SeyID was being integrated with eGovernment services and financial institutions](<https://idtechwire.com/seychelles-makes-digital-id-mandatory-for-work-permit-holders>). On 4 April 2025 the Central Bank [directed banks, payment providers and other reporting entities](<https://www.cbs.sc/Downloads/publications/aml/Directives/CBS_Directive_1_of_2025-_SeyID_.pdf>) to begin integrating SeyID into customer due diligence, with physical ID still accepted. [The Agency for Social Protection launched its ASP Connect platform internally on 15 October 2025](<https://www.nation.sc/articles/27935/asp-launches-digital-system>), reached through the SeyID portal. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 shows services in two or more sectors checking against the ID. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID, shown by sources from the past three years.

[In April 2025 the telecoms regulator ARCEP said every SIM card sold must be linked to a national identification number](<https://www.letchadanthropus-tribune.com/tchad-securite-larcep-sonnera-lalerte-sur-lappartenance-des-cartes-sim/>). It added that some are still sold pre-activated, with no identity check. In the last twelve months, on 8 May 2026 the secure titles agency ANATS and Airtel Tchad [signed a partnership to identify mobile subscribers](<https://tchadinfos.com/2026/05/09/securisation-des-donnees-lanats-et-airtel-tchad-signent-un-partenariat-strategique/>). ANATS is to verify Airtel's customer data, and the two systems are to be linked. No source found since October 2023 shows a service in use checking people against the ID system. Establishing would need a service in use checking people against the national ID, such as SIM registration or a bank's KYC.

A [December 2024 decree requires telecom operators to record each subscriber's ANID identification number](<https://jo.gouv.tg/sites/default/files/JO/JOS_23_04_2025%20-70%20E%20ANNEE%20N%C2%B044%20BIS.pdf>) at SIM registration and to see the card, giving existing operators 12 months to comply. In the last twelve months, ANID's 2026 deck says [the unique identification number is used through verification and authentication](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-4-Togo-FINAL.pdf>) across the ecosystem. [It is used to sign in to the public services portal](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-4-Togo-FINAL.pdf>). The deck also shows [the identification number in use in microfinance institutions](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-2-4-Togo-FINAL.pdf>), without describing a check. Operating would need services in two or more sectors checking people against the national ID.

E-Houwiya is [open to banks for remote onboarding and KYC](<https://idtechwire.com/e-houwiya-a-milestone-in-tunisias-digital-transformation-roadmap-2025>) under Central Bank rules of February 2025. In the last twelve months, since 1 July 2026 [the national business register's procedures have required a digital identity](<https://home.registre-entreprises.tn/le-registre-national-des-entreprises-vers-le-full-digital/>), Mobile ID for people. A [September 2026 circular gives the agriculture ministry's bodies until 15 November 2026](<https://www.tunisie-tribune.com/2026/09/18/numerisation-le-ministere-de-lagriculture-integre-lidentite-numerique-e-houwiya-dici-novembre-2026/>) to authenticate users through E-Houwiya. The 2026 playbook lists [Tunisie Telecom, CNAM, CNSS, five banks, La Poste and insurers](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-2-Tunisia-FINAL.pdf>) among its integrators, with no total. Mature would need a figure for verifications made against the ID, or a count of the services relying on it.

In a 2025 presentation, [NIDA counts 124 institutions integrated with its consent-based eKYC, 55 government and 69 private](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/PS1-S1-2-Tanzania-final.pdf>). [The Ministry of Home Affairs counted 147 institutions connected to NIDA's system](<https://dailynews.co.tz/as-tanzania-goes-digital-who-protects-your-privacy/>). It put 66 as public and 81 as private, with 17 added from July 2025 to April 2026. In the last twelve months, by August 2026 the government spokesman said [157 institutions, 72 government and 85 private, were linked to NIDA's system](<https://www.jamhurimedia.co.tz/nida-yazindua-kampeni-ya-kipo-chukua-kamilisha-safari-yako/>) and could verify the people they serve.

URSB's ICT commissioner said in 2025 that business registration has a [real-time link with NIRA](<https://ursb.go.ug/2025/09/02/ursbs-digital-transformation-enhances-service-access-and-transparency/>) for identity verification. [The Bank of Uganda reports 74 financial institutions with NIRA database access for KYC](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202410/uganda-financial-institutions-sign-on-for-digital-kyc-through-national-id>). In the last twelve months, NIRA says [10 of its 107 partner institutions were checking customers by NIN and biometrics through its new system by 28 October 2026](<https://edge.ug/new-national-id-verification-glitches-spark-delays-at-banks-agencies/>). In October 2026 the gender ministry said [43,000 older people could not draw SAGE cash grants](<https://nilepost.co.ug/news/379844/43000-elderly-ugandans-locked-out-of-sage-benefits-over-national-id-errors>). The ages on their national ID cards made them ineligible.

Banks, mobile networks and insurers [use the population register check](<https://weetracker.com/2026/01/27/south-africa-id-verification-fee-court-case/>), among them Capitec, TymeBank, Vodacom and MTN, in a report of January 2026. In the last twelve months, SASSA [biometrically verified 997,379 grant beneficiaries](<https://pmg.org.za/committee-question/37674/>) from September 2025 to March 2026. Home Affairs says [the justice cluster alone runs over 180,000 checks a day](<https://www.gov.za/news/media-statements/home-affairs-launch-world-class-new-identity-verification-service-and-cost>) through its service. In September 2026 the minister said [voter registration is verified through an electronic interface with the population register](<https://pmg.org.za/committee-question/40687/>).

[The FISP e-Voucher farm-input subsidy uses eKYC checks to cut ghost beneficiaries](<https://www.pdu.gov.zm/blog/how-fisp-e-voucher-is-delivering-support-where-it-matters-most>). It ran in all 116 districts by January 2026. [Developers were trained in 2025 to link the SmartCarePro health record to the ID](<https://idtechwire.com/zambia-advances-digital-id-system-with-mosip-training-for-healthcare-integration>). In the last twelve months, in May 2026 the Bank of Zambia said [Home Affairs charges banks about 80 cents for each successful API check](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/id4africa-panel-outlines-steady-kyc-process-policy-improvement>). The central bank is also [building a central eKYC platform on the Home Affairs digital ID](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202605/id4africa-panel-outlines-steady-kyc-process-policy-improvement>). No figure for checks against the ID has been found. Mature would need a source from the past three years giving a figure for verifications made against the ID, or counting the services relying on it.

In June 2026 the Reserve Bank governor said [all mobile money providers verify customers against the Civil Registry](<https://www.heraldonline.co.zw/rbz-closes-loopholes-on-mobile-money-illicit-financial-flows-fraud/>) at onboarding and in later reviews. [Ghost and duplicate wallets were shut down](<https://businesstimes.co.zw/rbz-shuts-down-ghost-wallets/>) once the registry was linked to subscriber records. In the last twelve months, in July 2026 the Justice Minister said [the Electoral Commission was already using the Registrar-General's population database](<https://www.zbcnews.co.zw/registrar-general-to-take-over-voters-roll-under-constitutional-reforms/>) to verify voters. Nothing found gives a figure for checks made against the Civil Registry. Mature would need a figure for verifications made against the ID, or a count of the services relying on it.
